definitions.gloss: cold wind; bitter wind; icy wind
definitions.explanation: A harsh, cold wind, especially one that blows in winter. A somewhat literary or formal word that conveys the biting severity of the cold.

examples.japanese: {寒風|かんぷう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}きすさぶ。
{寒風|かんぷう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んだ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: I stood in line in the bitter wind.

examples.japanese: {寒風|かんぷう}{吹|ふ}きすさぶ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked alone along the winter coast where bitter winds were blowing.

notes:
A literary/formal word for a harsh cold wind. More evocative and literary than simply ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (cold wind). Often used in descriptive writing and news reports about winter weather.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寒風|かんぷう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧: a cold wind blows
- {寒風|かんぷう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}きすさぶ: bitter wind howls
- {寒風|かんぷう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧さらされる: to be exposed to the bitter wind
- {寒風|かんぷう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: in the bitter cold wind

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{北風|きたかぜ}→北風：21247_kitakaze⟧: north wind — specifies direction; not necessarily literary
- ⟦{木枯|こが}らし→木枯らし：08557_kogarashi⟧: cold wintry wind — specifically the first cold wind of late autumn/early winter
- {烈風|れっぷう}: fierce wind — emphasizes violence of the wind, not necessarily cold

FORMS:
{寒|かん} (cold) + {風|ぷう} (wind)
